description: Recorded JSON-RPC sessions over stdio, driven through a scripted process. Each case lists sessions (one per start, in order: the stderr written at start, the answers to the requests in order, and the exit code when stopped) and ops applied in order. Expected: one result per op, the wire (every message the client wrote, in order), and the log lines (durations dropped, the executable named node). A silent answer is the client's timer firing on the fake clock. A session may set spawn_error, so the program cannot start, and a reply may set process_error, so the process fails without ending. A case may set npm to false, for a machine with no npm. An object {"repeat": text, "count": n} stands for its text repeated n times.
